[NAV] Open Catalog module > open srcCatalog
[ACT] Create category parentCat in srcCatalog root
[ACT] Open parentCat > create subcategory childCat inside it
[ASSERT] Both parentCat and childCat report CatalogId = srcCatalog
[ACT] Select parentCat > Cut (toolbar or right-click)
[NAV] Open dstCatalog
[ACT] Paste parentCat into dstCatalog root
[WAIT] Wait for move operation to complete
[ASSERT] parentCat now appears under dstCatalog tree

[STATE] Move completes without error
[STATE] parentCat CatalogId updated to dstCatalog
[STATE] childCat (descendant) CatalogId cascaded to dstCatalog
